problem.tokenRejected.note: message: Meta's own explanation, in English as Meta sent it

problem.unknownId.message: Meta doesn't know this ID, or the token can't reach it: {message}
problem.unknownId.note: message: Meta's own explanation, in English as Meta sent it

problem.metaUnavailable: Meta's Graph API didn't answer. Try again in a moment.

problem.metaAnswered.note: an error Meta's Graph API gave that ReputeCast has no words for; message: Meta's own, in English

problem.alreadyConnectedDisconnect: WhatsApp is already connected. Disconnect it first to use another account.

problem.businessIdNumber.message: The WhatsApp Business Account ID is a number, from WhatsApp Manager › Account tools.
problem.businessIdNumber.note: WhatsApp Manager › Account tools is a path in Meta's own screens: keep it as Meta names it

problem.phoneIdNumber.message: The phone number ID is a number, from your app's WhatsApp › API setup page.
problem.phoneIdNumber.note: WhatsApp › API setup is a path in Meta's own screens: keep it as Meta names it

problem.replaceWhat: Enter the value to replace: the access token, the app secret or an ID.

problem.phoneFormat.message: Enter the number with its country code, like +1 312 555 0123.
problem.phoneFormat.note: +1 312 555 0123 is an example number: keep it

problem.pickApprovedTemplate: Pick one of the account's approved templates.
problem.noApprovedTemplate: The account has no approved template yet: a test is a template message. Create one in WhatsApp Manager.
problem.syncTokenRejected: Meta rejected the access token. Replace it to sync the templates.
problem.pickList: Pick a list of this workspace.

problem.onlyApproved.message: Only approved templates can be picked: {name} is {status, select, pending {pending} rejected {rejected} paused {paused} disabled {disabled} in_appeal {in appeal} other {{status}}}.
problem.onlyApproved.note: name: the template's name (summit_day_before), never translated

problem.notEditable.message: This campaign is {status, select, scheduled {scheduled} sending {sending} paused {paused} sent {sent} cancelled {cancelled} failed {failed} other {{status}}}: it can't be edited any more.

problem.staleSaved.message: Someone saved a newer version ({version}). Reload to see it.

problem.futureTime: Pick a time in the future.
problem.dayAndTime: Pick a day and a time.

problem.insideWindow.message: Pick a time inside the quiet-hours window, {window}.
problem.insideWindow.note: window: the hours texts and messages may go out in, 08:00–21:00

problem.unknownField.message: {variable} takes a contact field this workspace doesn't have: {field}.
problem.unknownField.note: variable: a template variable, {{1}}; field: the field's key, plan

problem.templateNotApproved: The campaign's template isn't approved: pick an approved one.
problem.evidence: WhatsApp consent needs its evidence: the exact consent text, where it was given and when.
problem.futureConsent: Consent can't be given in the future.

problem.optedOutStart.message: This number opted out on WhatsApp. Only the person can come back, by writing START.
problem.optedOutStart.note: START is the keyword people write: never translated

problem.tokenReplaceFirst: Meta rejected the access token: replace it in Sending providers › WhatsApp first.
problem.windowClosed: The customer service window is closed: free-form replies go only to people who wrote in the last 24 hours. Send an approved template instead.

problem.windowClosedAt.message: The customer service window closed at {date} {time}. Send an approved template instead.
problem.windowClosedAt.note: date: 15 Oct; time: 18:02, in the workspace's time zone

problem.optedOut: This number opted out on WhatsApp.

problem.alreadyStatus.message: This campaign is already {status, select, scheduled {scheduled} sending {sending} paused {paused} sent {sent} cancelled {cancelled} failed {failed} other {{status}}}.

problem.staleReviewed.message: The campaign changed since you reviewed it (now version {version}). Review it again.

problem.blocking: Fix the blocking checks before sending.
problem.unscheduleOnly: Only a scheduled campaign that hasn't started can go back to a draft.
problem.cancelOnly: Only a scheduled or sending campaign can be cancelled.

problem.ratesDate.message: Enter the rate card's date, like 2026-10-01.
problem.ratesDate.note: 2026-10-01 is the date format the field takes: keep it

problem.ratesDuplicate: Each country and category has one price.

problem.ratesDefault.message: Keep a price for every other country (*) in each category you send.
problem.ratesDefault.note: * is how the rate card writes every other country

label.now.note: a campaign's schedule: it goes as soon as it's sent

label.local.note: a campaign's schedule: 21 Oct, 09:00 in each recipient's time zone

label.copyOf.note: the name of a duplicated campaign; name: the campaign's name

label.field.first_name.note: contact fields a template variable can take

language.en_US.note: a WhatsApp template's language, as Meta names its codes

reason.invalid_format.note: why Meta rejected a template, in ReputeCast's words, until Meta's own words arrive

reason.abusive_content: Meta found content that breaks its policies.
reason.incorrect_category: The category doesn't match the content.
reason.tag_content_mismatch: The content doesn't match the category.
reason.scam: Meta flagged the content as a possible scam.

reason.promotional.message: The content is promotional: use the Marketing category.
reason.promotional.note: Marketing is a template category, as the Templates tab names it

notify.tokenTitle.message: Meta rejected the WhatsApp access token: it {reason, select, expired {expired} other {was refused}}

notify.tokenSummary.message: WhatsApp sends are held until the token is replaced
notify.tokenSummary.note: the notification's short line in the bell

notify.tokenSummaryHeld.note: the notification's short line in the bell; names: the campaigns and automations waiting, joined with commas

notify.tokenBody: WhatsApp sends are held until the token is replaced. Nothing has been lost yet. Enter a new permanent access token in Sending providers › WhatsApp to reconnect.

notify.qualityTitle.message: WhatsApp quality dropped to {quality, select, high {High} medium {Medium} low {Low} other {Unknown}}
notify.qualityTitle.note: a notification's title; quality: Meta's quality rating

notify.qualitySummary: Quality rating {quality, select, high {High} medium {Medium} low {Low} other {Unknown}}, was {previous, select, high {High} medium {Medium} low {Low} other {Unknown}}

notify.qualitySummaryLimit.message: Quality rating {quality, select, high {High} medium {Medium} low {Low} other {Unknown}}, was {previous, select, high {High} medium {Medium} low {Low} other {Unknown}} · messaging limit {limit, number} a day, was {previousLimit, number}
notify.qualitySummaryLimit.note: limit, previousLimit: people a day Meta lets the business start conversations with

notify.qualityBody: More people blocked or reported recent messages. At Low, Meta can limit the number of people you can message further.

notify.rejectedTitle.note: a notification's title; name: the template's name, never translated

notify.rejectedSummaryMeta.note: reason: Meta's own words, in English as Meta sent them

notify.rejectedSummaryCode.message: Meta rejected {name}: “{code, select, invalid_format {The template's format isn't valid.} abusive_content {Meta found content that breaks its policies.} incorrect_category {The category doesn't match the content.} tag_content_mismatch {The content doesn't match the category.} scam {Meta flagged the content as a possible scam.} promotional {The content is promotional: use the Marketing category.} other {{reason}}}”
notify.rejectedSummaryCode.note: the reasons are reason.*'s, worded the same

notify.rejectedBody: Fix the template in WhatsApp Manager and submit it again; ReputeCast picks up the new status at the next sync.

stored.page.note: where consent changed, on the contact's timeline: by writing a WhatsApp message

stored.optedOut.note: a consent change on the contact's timeline

webhook.whatsapp.delivered.note: a webhook event, in Settings › Webhooks

webhook.whatsapp.read: A person read a WhatsApp message (only people who share read receipts).
webhook.whatsapp.failed: A WhatsApp message failed, with the reason and Meta's code.
webhook.whatsapp.replied: A person wrote or tapped a quick reply: the 24-hour window opens.
webhook.whatsapp.opted_out: A number wrote an opt-out keyword: WhatsApp consent withdrawn on every list.
webhook.whatsapp.opted_in: A number wrote an opt-in keyword: the consents the opt-out removed came back.
webhook.whatsapp.template_status: Meta approved, rejected, paused or disabled a template.
